python_basics.description: Covers Python syntax, data types, loops, conditionals, and functions.
python_basics.who_needs_it: Anyone unfamiliar with Python fundamentals, or who struggles with simple programs or debugging basic syntax errors.
python_basics.skills_gained: Ability to write small Python scripts, use loops, and define functions.

data_structures.description: Teaches lists, dictionaries, tuples, sets, and basic algorithms.
data_structures.who_needs_it: Learners who can code in Python but do not know how to store, search, or manipulate collections efficiently.
data_structures.skills_gained: Understanding of choosing data structures and implementing common algorithms.

sql_database.description: Covers relational database design and SQL queries.
sql_database.who_needs_it: Anyone who hasn’t used SQL, JOINs, or database schema design before.
sql_database.skills_gained: Ability to design simple databases and write SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE queries.

machine_learning.description: Introduces core ML concepts with scikit-learn: regression, classification, model evaluation.
machine_learning.who_needs_it: Learners new to predictive modeling or unsure how to train and test models.
machine_learning.skills_gained: Ability to build and evaluate basic ML models in Python.

deep_learning.description: Explores neural networks with PyTorch/TensorFlow and training pipelines.
deep_learning.who_needs_it: Learners without prior experience in neural network architectures or GPU training.
deep_learning.skills_gained: Ability to design and train basic neural networks.
